commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+6' Las Palmas hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90+4' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) smashes the ball towards goal with a volley from close-range, but the goalkeeper uses his incredible reflexes to make a brilliant save.
90+2' Sevilla are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
89' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 49:51.

84' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

78' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
77' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
76' Substitution. Marvin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Viti (Las Palmas).

75' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.

74' A substitution has been made. Dodi Lukebakio goes off and Jesus Navas (Sevilla) comes on.

74' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
71' 2 - 2 Goal! Javier Munoz plays it to Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Orjan Nyland. 2:2.

64' Las Palmas keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
61' 1 - 2 It's 1:2! Isaac Romero feeds Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top of the net.

60' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francisco Maeso with no other option than to blow for a foul.

58' A pass travels right across the box to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland denies him with a decent save.
56' The Las Palmas players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
54' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
51' Sevilla are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
50' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
50' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.

47' Sevilla slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
44' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
42' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
40' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.

37' What a sweet touch by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post.
36' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Las Palmas are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
28' The rebound finds Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
27' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Las Palmas will have a corner.
26' Las Palmas keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
25' 0 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Alex Suarez (Las Palmas), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
20' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Las Palmas.

19' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) gets the ball from a rebound before trying his luck with a good long-range shot which threatens the goalkeeper! The ball sails painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
17' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.

15' Great solo effort by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Orjan Nyland is alert and denies him.
14' Las Palmas players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
12' Marvin (Las Palmas) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
10' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
9' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) swings in a cross from the corner, but Orjan Nyland reads it well and gathers the ball.
7' The Las Palmas players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

4' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
3' Las Palmas are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
2' Great teamplay by Las Palmas as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
